_about: Recorded agent output for fixture mode (phase 03 produces it live with Gemini).

log-recommendation-app-error.note: Almost all of these are one exception the background worker throws in a loop. Fixing the model-cache bug behind it would remove about {gib_month} a month ({eur_month} at your rates).

log-recommendation-app-error-modelweight.note: One exception thrown in a loop: {records_day} records a day, nobody has queried it in 30 days. Sift never drops ERROR logs. Fix the model-cache bug instead; that removes about {gib_month} a month ({eur_month}).
